messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
My foot tweaked out and I faceplanted in front of four black belts, my sister and Keava ( the nerdy guy who bugs the crap out of me ).

output.original_text: My foot tweaked out and I faceplanted in front of four black belts, my sister and Keava ( the nerdy guy who bugs the crap out of me ).
output.joy: I stumbled and did a hilarious faceplant right in front of four black belts, my sister, and Keava, the quirky guy who always gets on my nerves! What a crazy moment!
output.sadness: My foot gave out and I embarrassingly faceplanted in front of four black belts, my sister, and Keava – the nerdy guy who annoys me so much. It was just awful.
output.fear: My foot twisted unexpectedly and I faceplanted right in front of four black belts, my sister, and Keava, the annoying nerd. I couldn't help but feel a chill of embarrassment wash over me.
output.anger: My foot twisted out from under me, and I ended up faceplanting in front of four black belts, my sister, and Keava, that irritating guy who bugs the life out of me! How frustrating!
output.surprise: Out of nowhere, my foot tweaked, and I faceplanted in front of four black belts, my sister, and Keava, the nerdy guy who always bugs me. I couldn’t believe it!
output.disgust: My foot awkwardly twisted, and I faceplanted in front of four black belts, my sister, and Keava – that annoying nerd. It was just so cringe-worthy.
